info.title: Straight Salon API
info.description: Salon booking and management API. Errors use RFC 7807 problem details; every response carries X-Request-Id.

detail.example: The selected stylist is no longer free at 11:00.

accessToken.description: JWT, 15 minutes. Keep in memory only (05 §5).

updatedAt.description: Absent until an admin first saves settings (defaults are served)

example.bio: Precision cuts and beard styling, 8 years.

StaffProfile.description: Profile with the services the stylist performs (active ones for the public)

status.description: ok: all up. degraded: a non-critical dependency (Redis) is down, still serving (HTTP 200). error: a critical dependency (MongoDB) is down (HTTP 503). shutting_down: draining (HTTP 503).

get.description: The process is up. No dependency checks (03-backend §6).
Pings MongoDB (critical) and Redis (non-critical). Returns 503 if MongoDB is down or the process is shutting down; Redis down only degrades the status (03-backend §6).

503.description: Not ready (MongoDB down or shutting down)

409.description: Email or phone already registered (DUPLICATE, PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED)

post.description: 5 failed attempts for one email lock it for 15 minutes (429).
Reusing a rotated token revokes every session of that login (06 §2).

200.description: New access token; new refresh cookie

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or reused refresh token (UNAUTHENTICATED)

post.description: Always 202, whether or not the email has an account (no user enumeration).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token (API-007)
post.description: Ends every session of the account.

400.description: Invalid input, or invalid/expired/used token (VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_RESET_TOKEN)

post.description: Ends every other session; this device receives a fresh refresh cookie.

400.description: Validation failed or current password incorrect (VALIDATION_FAILED)

post.description: ADMIN. The slug is generated from the name.

patch.description: ADMIN. isActive: true reactivates a deactivated category.

delete.description: ADMIN. Soft delete: the category is hidden from the public list.

get.description: Active services, paginated, sorted by name by default. Filter by category, search words with q. Cached 10 min. ADMIN may pass includeInactive=true.

parameters.description: Words in the name or description

422.description: Duration is not a multiple of the slot granularity (INVALID_DURATION)

get.description: By id or slug, with the active stylists who perform it and its rating. Deactivated services are not found, except for ADMIN.

patch.description: ADMIN. null clears description or imageUrl. isActive: true reactivates (BR-013 re-checked).

409.description: Name used by an active service (DUPLICATE) or changed concurrently (STALE_VERSION)

422.description: Duration is not a multiple of the slot granularity (INVALID_DURATION)

delete.description: ADMIN. Hidden from the catalogue; historical bookings keep their snapshot (FR-013).

post.description: ADMIN. One `file` field: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB. The type is detected from the content, the image is re-encoded without metadata and stored under a random name. Set the returned url as services.imageUrl or staff.photoUrl.

file.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 2 MB

get.description: Full-day closures, by date ascending. Both bounds are optional and inclusive.

post.description: ADMIN. Fails with ACTIVE_BOOKINGS_EXIST when active bookings exist that day, unless force: true cancels them and notifies the customers.

force.description: Cancel the active bookings on that date and notify the customers instead of failing with ACTIVE_BOOKINGS_EXIST

get.description: Name, address, contact, business hours, timezone, currency and the booking policy the booking wizard needs. Cached 10 min.
ADMIN. Defaults are returned until settings are first saved.

put.description: ADMIN. Full replacement of every FR-080 field. A new slot granularity must fit every active service duration (BR-013). The timezone cannot change while future active bookings exist.

422.description: Granularity does not fit a service (INVALID_DURATION) or timezone change with future bookings (ACTIVE_BOOKINGS_EXIST)

get.description: Active stylists, public fields only, by name. Filter by a service they perform. Cached 10 min. ADMIN may pass includeInactive=true for every stylist with admin fields.

userId.description: An active user with role STAFF and no profile yet
